instruction: Buy me a air purifier on amazon from its highest-rated seller using my visa card for my home address.
notes: Single-app (amazon) purchase task. The highest-rated seller and its air purifier are abstracted as the objects top-seller / top-seller-air-purifier with static facts of-type, sold-by and top-rated-seller; the agent realizes them at runtime by searching products of type 'air purifier', calling show_seller for each candidate seller_id and picking the max rating (the reference solution may call show_seller several times, hence 11 API calls vs. 9 plan steps). add_product_to_cart is modeled with quantity=1 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one item of quantity 1 (CartEntry changes are ignored by the evaluation). Card and address ids are discovered via show_payment_cards (card_name 'Visa') and show_addresses (name 'Home'); addresses are never modified. place_order records order-placed with product, quantity, card and address, which is the sole task-specific goal and the precondition of supervisor-complete-task (no answer parameter since the task asks no question).

plan: (amazon-add-product-to-cart top-seller-air-purifier amazon-token qty-1 true top-seller air-purifier)
(amazon-place-order visa-card home-address amazon-token order-1 top-seller-air-purifier qty-1)
